name: Patrick Halpin
occupation: Chair, Town of Babylon Planning Board; former Suffolk County Executive

supports: Lowering costs for rent, child care and medical bills
positions.quote: Lowering costs from rent to childcare to medical bills
positions.impact: Expect support for federal measures on housing, child care and medical costs. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Health care that doesn't depend on where you live, your job or your income
positions.quote: Healthcare shouldn't depend on your ZIP code, your job, or your bank account.
positions.impact: He would vote to widen access to coverage. The agenda page doesn't name a specific bill.

supports: A secure, orderly and fair immigration system
positions.quote: Keeping our communities safe starts with strong leadership, support for law enforcement, and an immigration system that is secure, orderly, and fair.
positions.impact: He would back immigration measures that pair enforcement with legal processes. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: In Congress, I'll continue fighting to make polluters pay, protect clean water and clean air, strengthen climate resilience, and keep Long Island healthy for generations to come.
positions.impact: Expect support for federal pollution penalties and coastal resilience funding for Long Island. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
